Hi Emily / Rajiv —

Thanks again for signing up for our evening cohort demo. We typically run these as group sessions (3–5 prospects) to cover architecture, latency/cost tradeoffs, and a short Q&A. To get this scheduled, could you each confirm which of these 30-minute slots works for your team next week (Pacific times):

- Option A: Tue 5/18 17:00–17:30 PT
- Option B: Wed 5/19 18:00–18:30 PT
- Option C: Thu 5/20 16:30–17:00 PT (earlier host availability)

Notes:
- We can handle up to six prospect seats but prefer 3–4 to keep Q&A focused.
- Agenda (draft) attached; will circulate a final copy once slot is locked.
- Quick poll: if none of these work, reply with 2–3 preferred windows and timezones.

Would you also confirm: 1) expected number of attendees on your side, and 2) any topic you want us to prioritize (privacy, batching, deployment modes)?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate hosts once everyone confirms.
